outputs.explanation: Panel A is a 3D rendering/segmentation of tomographic data (preconoidal rings, actin filament, apical polar ring) — not a plot of averaged data, so no individual data points are required.
Panel B is a 3D structural rendering of segmented cellular components (ER, cytosolic actin, IMC) from tomography — not a quantitative plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel C is a raw tomogram slice image (micrograph) with filaments highlighted, not a plot of averaged/aggregated data.
Panel D is a schematic/3D rendering illustrating the lateral section with labeled structures, not a quantitative plot.
Panel E is a micrograph slice through an averaged tomographic volume (image data), not a bar/summary plot requiring individual data point overlay.
Panel F is a tomogram slice (micrograph) with annotated densities, not a plot of averaged values.
